section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) with 215 heterosexual women recruited from community spaces, email listservs, and social media in Ottawa, Canada. Participants had a mean age of 38.08 years, were predominantly Caucasian (88.5%), highly educated (88% with postsecondary education), and had a mean BMI of 26.11 (self-reported). The study investigated how women relate to their bodies across adulthood and its effects on sexual health.
